# app-agents

> Agents for apps. Installable Standard Agents, one npm package per app.

Install the CLI: npm install -g @app-agents/cli

Commands:
- `app-agents list` — every app, expert, status and permission mode
- `app-agents search <query>` — by app name, alias, or job
- `app-agents show <app>` — capabilities, credentials, platform gates
- `app-agents auth <app>` — what an operator must provide
- `app-agents add <app>` — install the package

Registry (machine readable): https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/app-agents/agents@main/registry.json
Registry schema: schema 1; fields: app, title, aliases, package, connector, credentials, experts[], gate, dataRetention

Apps:

## gmail
- package: @app-agents/gmail
- aliases: gmail, google mail, googlemail, workspace mail, inbox
- connector: rest · oauth · read-only
- expert inbox_triage (beta): decides which messages need the reader, why, and writes the replies. Read-only.
- credentials: GOOGLE_ACCESS_TOKEN with scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/gmail.readonly
- gate: restricted scope; external users need Google app verification and a CASA assessment. Testing-mode clients expire refresh tokens after 7 days.

## snapchat-ads
- package: @app-agents/snapchat-ads
- aliases: snapchat, snap, snap ads, snapchat ads, snap inc, ads manager
- connector: rest · oauth · read-only
- expert campaign_report (beta): reads delivery and spend across campaigns and ranks the one change most likely to help. Read-only.
- expert story_ad_launch (gap): publish a story ad end to end. Not built. Would require write capabilities and a confirm step.
- credentials: SNAP_ACCESS_TOKEN (Snap Marketing API)
- gate: read-only is self-service via Snap's Ads MCP; writing needs your own Snap app registration, Marketing API review, and a client id registered per agent.

Conventions:
- Agents are named after the app they are expert in, not the capability.
- The app slug is the lookup handle; one package per app; jobs live inside it.
- Every capability is declared in the app manifest with level read | write | confirm.
- Nothing not declared in the manifest is reachable.

Source: https://github.com/app-agents/agents
